interpretation_rules: A reported position is ownership/discretion evidence for a reporting date, not intent, entry date, cost, trade execution or net risk.
Publication date determines what was publicly knowable; report date alone does not.
Resolve filer, fund, account, included manager, CUSIP, security class, split basis, unit and currency before aggregation.
Keep longs separate from options/warrants; never silently repair inconsistent units.
Manager book is not personal portfolio and 13F is not complete economic exposure.
Holdings-value change combines prices, flows, trades and possibly manager-scope changes; never call it P&L.
Use full issuer/fund total-return series and appropriate benchmark/share class for return claims; a business result or selected quote is not an investment return.
latest_filing_calendar_only: ARK, Altimeter and Coatue submissions JSON were checked for Q2 2026 filing existence. Their latest information tables were not ingested.
case_selection_note: Famous successes and adverse cases were chosen purposively; no count, win rate or claim of investment-skill causality is supported.
